title: Kitchen exhaust ducts.
officialText:
The clearance reduction methods specified in Table 308.6 shall not be utilized to reduce the minimum
clearances required by Section 506.3.10 for kitchen exhaust ducts enclosed in a shaft.
SECTION MC 309
TEMPERATURE CONTROL
